sections.title: What Is Gold Class?
body: The I-CAR Gold Class program helps auto body repairers and insurers stay ahead with role-relevant education on evolving vehicle systems. More than 10,000 businesses have earned this recognition, setting the benchmark for industry excellence. When you commit to being Gold Class, you prioritize complete, safe, and quality repairs while supporting original equipment manufacturer standards that improve operational efficiency and build customer confidence.

sections.title: Program Paths
body: Gold Class supports collision repair facilities and insurance organizations with role-specific training paths tailored to how each business serves the repair process.

cards.title: Gold Class for Collision Repair
cards.body: Collision repair facilities earn Gold Class recognition through I-CAR's Professional Development Program. It includes specialized body shop training and certification that equips your team with the knowledge and skills needed to work on today's vehicles.
listItems: Enjoy a 20% discount on I-CAR training courses
Stand out as a top-tier collision repair provider
Enhance your team with specialized collision training
Able to enroll in collision repair and I-CAR Academy subscription programs

cards.title: Gold Class for Insurance
cards.body: Insurance companies achieve Gold Class status through I-CAR's Professional Development Program for Auto Physical Damage Appraisers (APDAs). This specialized insurance training helps to ensure accurate estimates and proper repair procedures.
listItems: Enjoy a 20% discount on professional development courses
Stand out as a premier vehicle insurance provider
Access specialized training for your team

sections.title: Find a Gold Class Shop
sections.label: What's New
body: Reviewing credentials helps customers choose a body shop they feel confident in to perform vehicle repairs. Achieving Gold Class adds your shop to our Gold Class locator, giving you visibility and setting you apart in your market.
